facts.value: Table 2: Main results. Outcome is the share of runs that reach all required outcomes.
facts.quote: Table 2: Main results. Outcome is the share of runs that reach all required outcomes. Pass@1 is the strict-pass rate averaged across three seeds. Light, Std., and Hard give the mean strict-pass rate on the 9 light, 15 standard, and 23 hard worlds.
facts.note: Outcome = share of runs reaching all required outcomes; Pass@1 = strict-pass rate averaged over three seeds (95% bootstrap CI over the 47 worlds); Pass^3 = share of worlds with a strict pass in all three seeds; Light/Std./Hard = mean strict-pass rate on 9 light, 15 standard, 23 hard worlds; "All results are ours"
